04 / Process

How it works

Set up once with a single walkthrough. After that you receive reports without asking for them.

Plan my first walkthrough
01

Walkthrough and baseline

We visit with you or with your agent, photograph the current state of every area, and build the checklist for your house. Shutoffs, breaker panel, equipment and access get documented.

02

Visits on a fixed calendar

You choose the frequency. We go on the agreed dates, run the same checklist every time, and photograph anything that changed since the last visit.

03

Report the same day

Status by area and photos before the day ends. If something is critical you get a call first, so a decision never waits on a written report.

04

Action if needed

Nothing gets repaired without your approval. You see the written quote first, and we coordinate the work once you say go.
